description: Use this when the user wants FlareWarden to email them more or fewer kinds of alert, pause or resume all alert emails, or change when SSL expiry warnings arrive. Changes only the settings given, for the user alone, and returns all of them after the change. Not for teammates' alerts, webhooks or chat channels.

certificate_changed.description: Email the user about Certificate Changed.

dns_failures.description: Email the user about DNS Failures and Changes.

domain_expiring.description: Email the user about Domain Expiring.

email_alerts.description: The master switch: false pauses every alert email to the user from this account.

issuer_changed.description: Email the user about Certificate Issuer Changed.

monitor_down.description: Email the user about Monitor Down.

monitor_recovered.description: Email the user about Monitor Recovered.

performance_anomalies.description: Email the user about Performance Anomalies.

ssl_critical_days.description: Last SSL expiry warning, in days (1-365).

ssl_expiring.description: Email the user about SSL Certificate Expiring.

ssl_tls_changes.description: Email the user about SSL/TLS Changes.

ssl_urgent_days.description: Second SSL expiry warning, in days (1-365). At least the critical days.

ssl_warning_days.description: First SSL expiry warning, in days before expiry (1-365). At least the urgent days.

name: update_my_notifications
title: Change my alert emails
